in_hebrew.name: Win
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend, Beloved, Victor
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Win הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'winos', meaning friend or beloved. The name Win also holds the significance of victory in various spiritual traditions. In Christianity, Win is associated with the Roman martyr Saint Winibald, who is celebrated for his devotion and victory over adversity.
